title: Dependency sidecar, schemaVersion 1
description: Stored at .opencode/workplan/<id>.dependencies.json. Missing sidecar means dependencies are UNRECORDED, not that work is independent. Semantic rules (existing targets, no self-dependency, acyclic, archived prerequisites) are checked separately and reported as 'dependencies: ...' issues.

terminalSummaries.description: Optional summaries of prerequisites archived by compaction, so dependency checks survive history pruning.

x-shiori-unknown-fields: Accepted and ignored on read; sidecar is replaced wholesale on write.
